BoomBox Draco glTF fixture from [Khronos glTF Sample Models](https://github.com/KhronosGroupArchives/glTF-Sample-Models/tree/main/2.0/BoomBox/glTF-Draco).

The [model README](https://github.com/KhronosGroupArchives/glTF-Sample-Models/blob/main/2.0/BoomBox/README.md) states that Microsoft waived copyright and related rights to this asset to the extent possible under law.

Only the glTF manifest and binary geometry buffer are included; textures are unnecessary for the mesh and UV import test.
